ModMetaData.name: SpeakYourMind
ModMetaData.author: AydheDev
ModMetaData.description: Give your pawns a voice—and something worth saying. Contextual AI expressions, short exchanges, creature-appropriate reactions, persistent memories and readable history. Display only: generated text never changes relationships, moods or jobs. Requires Harmony and exactly one compatible Interaction Bubbles implementation. Interaction Bubbles Expanded is the primary 1.7 target. Configure a provider or local model in mod settings before enabling generation. This is an early development build.
